comment: A difficulty ladder, in order. Each level multiplies the base numbers rather than replacing them, so content changes flow through automatically. A level is unlocked by reaching 'unlockRound' on the level before it, and the first is always available. Souls scale with the punishment, which is what makes climbing worth it once everything is bought.

difficulties.name: Journey
difficulties.description: The game as designed. Nothing is scaled.

difficulties.name: Classic
difficulties.description: Tougher creatures, and more souls for beating them.

difficulties.name: Expert
difficulties.description: Hits land harder and the shop offers one option fewer.

difficulties.name: Master
difficulties.description: Everything hurts, and you start with an empty purse.

difficulties.name: Legend
difficulties.description: A boss every fourth round, and no room for a mistake.
